blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A Chinese academic on Tuesday dismissed as “fake news” claims that China’s sweeping assertions encompass 90 percent of the South China Sea (SCS). Hu Bo, of the South China Sea Probing Initiative, said China only claims four island groups: the Spratly, Paracel, Pratas, and Macclesfield islands. He explained that Beijing’s nine-dash line merely defines the scope of its claims over the South China Sea.
